name: pandamonium
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Pandamonium instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Pandamonium tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Pandamonium through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Pandamonium Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Pandamonium only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
